# F5 stage A: post-hoc analyses (post-hoc, exploratory)

**Post-hoc, exploratory.** Written after the stage-A test; the analyses are fixed in `prereg/21_f5_stageA_posthoc_plan.md` (SHA-256 `442b53ff7f8c`). Nothing here enters or changes a stage-A verdict. Generated by `scripts/f5_stageA_posthoc.py`; checked by `scripts/verify_report.py` (`check_f5_stageA_posthoc`).

Primary post-hoc test: mean d = R2(true) - R2(shuffled) at 30 deg/s on the validation seeds 0.4509 (95 % bootstrap interval 0.4207 to 0.4837, 10 seeds); one-sided exact p 0.0010 (1/1024). Label: **replicated on the validation seeds (post-hoc)**.

## A. Speed generalisation on the validation seeds

Validation data seeds 160-199. The held-out speeds (30, 90 deg/s) were read for the first time by the post-hoc reader; the training speeds (60, 120 deg/s) through `load_trials`. Test-split values are read from `docs/results/f5_stageA_report.json`; no test record was opened.

### A.0 Consistency check (prereg/21 section 2)

Validation metrics at the training speeds recomputed on the CPU against the evaluation logged at the selected step: 50 of 50 runs pass (largest |delta R2| 1.23e-07, largest |delta loss| 1.00e-08; tolerance 1e-04 each, equal sign accuracy). The held-out-speed records were read only after this check passed.

- One-sided exact sign-flip test (all 1024 sign patterns, H1: mean d > 0 (the direction of the test result)): p = 0.0010 (1/1024); two-sided p = 0.0020 (2/1024).
- Effect size: mean d 0.4509, 95 % percentile bootstrap interval 0.4207 to 0.4837 (10,000 resamples of the seeds, `default_rng(21)`).
- Label: **replicated on the validation seeds (post-hoc)** (mean d > 0 and one-sided p < 0.05).

## B. Structure (prereg/21 section 4, descriptive)

No training and no record: the `true` VNC graph and the 10 cached `shuffled` graphs. Sources: the 305 bridge-target DNs (152 left, 153 right); targets: the 16 readout MNs; 4,880 (DN, MN) pairs. Rank 1 = largest of 11 graphs (ties: average rank); z = (value - shuffled mean) / shuffled SD. No test.

`true` lies outside the range of the 10 shuffled graphs on 14 of 18 measures (S1, S2, S3, S4, S5, S6, S7, S10, S11, S12, S13, S14, S17, S18). Of 54 uncorrected structure-deficit correlations, 0 reach |rho| >= 0.648 (about 2.7 expected by chance); the largest is S16 with D3, rho = 0.636.

## Limitations (prereg/21 section 7)

- The direction of the primary post-hoc test and the choice of 30 deg/s were made after seeing the test result.
- The validation seeds are not independent of model selection: the learning rate and the checkpoint were chosen on the validation loss of the same data seeds at the training speeds. The held-out-speed records of these seeds were never used.
- The 30 deg/s teacher is small (K_P x 30 deg/s), so the R2 at 30 deg/s, computed over the 80 rotation trials of that speed only, is sensitive to small offsets.
- Part B has one `true` graph: its rank among 11 graphs is descriptive, and the structure-deficit correlations have n = 10 with no correction.
